name: Chymical Wedding

phase_0.boundary_condition: The Hermetic Vessel of the Seven Days

VINIT.justification: The undifferentiated chaotic substance before the initiatory process begins.

TANCH.justification: The final containment and completion of the alchemical work within the palace.

AFWD.justification: The upward movement of the soul through the seven stages of initiation.

AREV.justification: The necessary descent into the darkness of the tomb to facilitate rebirth.

CLINK.justification: The sequential chaining of specific initiatory tasks and trials.

IMSCRIB.justification: The self-aware protagonist who must recognize his own name and role to proceed.

FSPLIT.justification: The divergence at the crossroads where the seeker must choose a specific direction.

FFUSE.justification: The reunification of the seeker's intent and path into a single trajectory toward the castle.

EVALT.justification: The successful attainment of a merit-based reward or passage.

EVALF.justification: The failure to meet the required spiritual weight during the judgment.

ENGAGR.justification: The divine hermaphrodite representing the simultaneous union of opposites without resolution.

IFIX.justification: The permanent and irreversible recording of the initiate's status in the royal book.

phase_3.void_description: The unmanifest state of the uninvited or the profane before the letter arrives.
phase_3.true_description: The state of the worthy initiate who has passed the scales of judgment.
phase_3.false_description: The state of the pretender who is cast out from the wedding feast.
phase_3.both_description: The state of the chemical marriage where King and Queen are one flesh.
